Lina (AE): Heads up — customer's legal asked for an EU-only POC (data plane), BYOK, and an explicit subprocessor snapshot for the pilot window. 2 weeks target. Can the team support?
Marco (SE): Clarify: control plane telemetry ok to leave EU? they said yes for metadata-only but want payloads never leave EU boundaries.
Lina (AE): Correct — metadata control plane ok, payloads and logs must remain inside EU for POC.
Ravi (Ops): We can assign a dedicated EU tenant with pinned pools. Need to verify model variants available in eu-central & eu-west. BYOK: KMS connector in eu-west-1 is available. BYO-HSM not feasible for a 2-week POC.
Anya (Security): I'll prepare the short attestation + updated SCQ entries stating subprocessors for the POC timeframe and the non-export guarantee. Ops: need confirmation of where traces/metrics get flushed.
Clara (Pricing): FYI regional-only capacity and BYOK connector will add infra and ops overhead. Rough delta for a 2-week reserved bucket + support: ~€7k-11k. Will formalize in a quote.
Marco (SE): Proposed POC checklist:
- Duration: 14 days
- Tenant residency: pinned eu-west-1 (primary)
- BYOK: customer supplies key ARN, mapped via KMS connector
- Subprocessors: snapshot provided for POC dates
- Failover policy: no automatic cross-border failover; queue + notify; manual failover needs explicit written approval
Ravi (Ops): Implementation plan:
```
- create tenant: id=finpoc-2026
- residency: eu
- pool: eu-west-1 (fallback eu-central-1 hot-standby within EU)
- models: prefer quantized EU variants, else fallback to same-family cascade within EU
- kms_bind: external_key_arn -> key mapping
- observability: eu-only export for traces/metrics/logs during window
- fallback_policy: queue_notify
```
Ravi (Ops): Note: if EU pool is saturated we can either queue or return 429. Autoscale will only use EU capacity if strict_pin true.
Lina (AE): Customer said queuing is acceptable but they want an escalation path if median latency degrades beyond agreed SLO.
Anya (Security): Add 24h notice clause to attestation for any cross-border failover during POC. Also will request ops to redact any non-essential PII from traces.
Ravi (Ops): Confirmed: can flip observability exports to EU-only for this tenant and provide a per-day subprocessor snapshot (storage provider, infra provider, monitoring partner). Will schedule config change during low traffic.
Clara (Pricing): I'll include reserved GPU hours, engineering oncall and setup time, and the BYOK connector cost. Putting formal quote into internal doc and will share link.
Marco (SE): Also flag: a few smaller optimized variants live only in non-EU pools; we'll provide evaluation prompts and a quick quality delta report so they can approve model tradeoffs.
deploy-bot: residency-pin apply triggered for tenant finpoc-2026 -> job#9072 queued.
Lina (AE): Action items: Marco prepare POC tech packet + eval harness. Ravi produce subprocessor snapshot and ops playbook. Anya finalize attestation & SCQ. Clara send quote by EOD. I'll deliver packet to customer tomorrow.
Clara (Pricing): Quote posted: https://redwood.internal/quotes/POC-1754299876 (internal)
Ravi (Ops): Adding runbook entry: maintenance window + contact list for manual failover.
Anya (Security): Will attach signed attestation PDF to the packet.
Lina (AE): Thanks team :rocket: — aiming to get customer sign-off and start next week.
